01

“and We made you peoples and tribes”

An explanation transmitted from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 49:13).

901
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr No. 901: 1

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
901: 1. Sufyan, from Abu Husayn, from Said ibn Jubayr, on His words
"and We made you peoples and tribes": He said, the peoples are like Tamim and Bakr, and the tribes are the subdivisions [afkhadh, literally "thighs"] (verse 13).
العربية
901: 1 سفيان عَنْ أَبِي حُصَيْنٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ شعوبا ووقبائل الذي قَالَ الشُّعُوبُ نَحْوَ تَمِيمٍ وَبَكْرٍ والقبايل لأن الأفخاذ (الآية 13) .

02

“The Bedouins say, 'We have believed.' Say, 'You have not…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 49:14).

902
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 902: 2

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
902: 2. Sufyan, from Ziyad, from Qays ibn Sad, from Mujahid, on His words
"The Bedouins say, 'We have believed.' Say, 'You have not believed, but say, "We have submitted"'": He said, they submitted when they feared killing and capture (verse 14).
العربية
902: 2 سفيان عَنْ زِيَادٍ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ قَالَتِ الأَعْرَابُ آمَنَّا قُلْ لَمْ تؤمنوا ولكن قولوا أسلمنا قَالَ اسْتَسْلَمُوا حِينَ خَشُوا الْقَتْلَ والسبا (الآية 14) .
